Home

Cloud Storage Made Simple

Gofile provides reliable, secure cloud storage for all your content needs. Store your files securely using our high-performance infrastructure, organize them easily, and share when needed.

File Manager Organize and manage your content
Desktop App SOON Synchronize files locally

Drag & drop your files here

or

Select files

For advanced features and content management, use the file manager.

Why Gofile

Everything you need to store and share

Free for quick shares — with fair and predictable pricing when you need permanence or scale.

Free

$0 no account required

Gofile is free to use — upload and share files instantly, no account required. Files are kept temporarily, perfect for quick shares. When you need permanent storage or global distribution, Premium takes it from there.

Storage

$3 per TB / month

Keep your files for the long haul with reliable multi-region storage — one of the most competitive rates around, with your files always accessible.

Distribution

$2 per TB of traffic

Reach a global audience. Our high-performance CDN keeps downloads fast anywhere in the world, with straightforward per-TB pricing.

Instant Sharing

No registration, no setup. Upload and share from the homepage in one click — your share link is ready before the upload even finishes.

Powerful File Manager

A complete cloud storage interface: content imports, recycle bin management, granular access permissions and advanced upload options — plus search, tags and descriptions.

Multiple Accounts

Attach several accounts and switch between them instantly — uploads keep running, no matter which account is active. A capability most services do not offer.

Privacy by Design

No tracking, no third-party tools. Every component of the platform is designed, built and operated in-house.

No Throttling

Uploads and downloads run at full speed — we never throttle bandwidth. This is separate from traffic allowances, which may apply per account.

Security & Reliability

Over a decade of operation with zero data loss and no security incidents. Your data is replicated across multiple datacenters for resilience.

API & Automation

A REST API for automation, custom integrations and AI agents — upload, organize and distribute content programmatically.

Growing Together

Gofile is in beta and actively evolving — tell us what to build next.
